conversations.title: Paying in Cash
conversations.description: Pay for a small item using cash and receive your change.

messages.text: Buongiorno. Sono cinque euro, per favore. Paga in contanti o con la carta?
messages.english: Good morning. It's five euros, please. Are you paying in cash or by card?

choices.text: Buongiorno. Pago in contanti. Ecco a lei dieci euro.
choices.english: Good morning. I am paying in cash. Here are ten euros for you.
choices.feedback: Perfect. You specified the payment method and handed the money.

choices.text: Buongiorno. Il bancomat non funziona bene oggi.
choices.english: Good morning. The ATM is not working well today.
choices.feedback: This is true, but you need to answer how you are paying.

choices.text: Buongiorno. Prendo un caffè e un cornetto, grazie.
choices.english: Good morning. I'll take a coffee and a croissant, thanks.
choices.feedback: You already ordered, now you have to pay.

messages.text: Grazie. Ha una moneta da un euro o da due euro?
messages.english: Thank you. Do you have a one euro or two euro coin?

choices.text: No, mi dispiace, non ho monete. Ho solo questa banconota.
choices.english: No, I'm sorry, I don't have coins. I only have this banknote.
choices.feedback: Great. You clearly explained that you only have a banknote.

choices.text: Sì, ho una carta di credito nuova per pagare.
choices.english: Yes, I have a new credit card to pay with.
choices.feedback: The host is asking for coins, not a credit card.

choices.text: No, mi dispiace, il ristorante è chiuso ora.
choices.english: No, I'm sorry, the restaurant is closed now.
choices.feedback: This makes no sense in this context.

messages.text: Va bene, nessun problema. Ecco il suo resto, cinque euro, e lo scontrino.
messages.english: Alright, no problem. Here is your change, five euros, and the receipt.

choices.text: Perfetto, grazie mille. Arrivederci e buona giornata!
choices.english: Perfect, thank you very much. Goodbye and have a good day!
choices.feedback: Polite and correct way to end the transaction.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno, per favore? È molto urgente adesso.
choices.english: Where is the bathroom, please? It's very urgent now.
choices.feedback: You can ask this later, but first acknowledge the change.

choices.text: Il conto è sbagliato, mancano venti centesimi qui.
choices.english: The bill is wrong, twenty cents are missing here.
choices.feedback: The change is exactly five euros, so it's correct.

messages.text: Grazie a lei. Ha bisogno di un sacchetto per portare via?
messages.english: Thank you. Do you need a bag to take away?

choices.text: No, grazie. Posso metterlo nella mia borsa. Arrivederci.
choices.english: No, thanks. I can put it in my bag. Goodbye.

choices.text: Sì, voglio pagare con il bancomat adesso, grazie.
choices.english: Yes, I want to pay by debit card now, thanks.

choices.text: No, grazie. Sono arrivato molto in ritardo oggi.
choices.english: No, thanks. I arrived very late today.

messages.text: D'accordo, arrivederci e a presto!
messages.english: Alright, goodbye and see you soon!

choices.text: A presto, grazie ancora per il suo aiuto oggi.
choices.english: See you soon, thanks again for your help today.
choices.feedback: A very friendly way to say goodbye.

choices.text: Devo andare di corsa in aeroporto adesso, scusa.
choices.english: I have to rush to the airport now, sorry.
choices.feedback: No need to mention the airport.

choices.text: La porta è bloccata e non riesco a uscire subito.
choices.english: The door is locked and I can't get out right away.
choices.feedback: You are just leaving the counter, not a locked room.

messages.text: Scusi, aspetti un momento! Ha dimenticato il suo ombrello qui sul bancone.
messages.english: Excuse me, wait a moment! You forgot your umbrella here on the counter.

choices.text: Oh, grazie mille! Sarei dovuto tornare indietro a prenderlo.
choices.english: Oh, thank you very much! I would have had to come back to get it.
choices.feedback: Great! You thanked the cashier for noticing.

choices.text: Non è il mio ombrello, io odio la pioggia.
choices.english: It's not my umbrella, I hate the rain.
choices.feedback: It's better to accept the umbrella gracefully in this context.

choices.text: Il conto non è giusto, mancano cinque euro da qui.
choices.english: The bill is not right, five euros are missing from here.

messages.text: Di nulla. Fuori piove molto forte in questo momento?
messages.english: You're welcome. Is it raining very hard outside right now?

choices.text: Sì, purtroppo piove a dirotto da questa mattina presto.
choices.english: Yes, unfortunately it's been pouring since early this morning.

choices.text: Voglio pagare in contanti, grazie mille.
choices.english: I want to pay in cash, thank you very much.

choices.text: Il mio ombrello è di colore blu scuro e molto grande.
choices.english: My umbrella is dark blue and very big.
choices.feedback: The host asked about the weather.

messages.text: Se vuole, può aspettare qui dentro finché non smette.
messages.english: If you want, you can wait inside here until it stops.

choices.text: Grazie, è molto gentile, ma devo andare al lavoro subito.
choices.english: Thanks, you are very kind, but I have to go to work immediately.

choices.text: No, il bancomat non funziona bene oggi.
choices.english: No, the ATM is not working well today.

choices.text: Il ristorante è chiuso per le vacanze estive adesso.
choices.english: The restaurant is closed for summer holidays now.

messages.text: Capisco perfettamente. Faccia attenzione per la strada, allora.
messages.english: I understand perfectly. Be careful on the road, then.

choices.text: Lo farò sicuramente. Grazie ancora per tutto e buona giornata.
choices.english: I certainly will. Thanks again for everything and have a good day.

choices.text: Devo andare a comprare una macchina nuova domani mattina.
choices.english: I have to go buy a new car tomorrow morning.

choices.text: Il treno parte tra cinque minuti, sono in ritardo.
choices.english: The train leaves in five minutes, I am late.

messages.text: Buona giornata a lei. Arrivederci!
messages.english: Have a good day too. Goodbye!

choices.text: Arrivederci e a presto!
choices.english: Goodbye and see you soon!

choices.text: Il caffè era molto freddo oggi.
choices.english: The coffee was very cold today.

choices.text: Non voglio pagare il conto adesso.
choices.english: I don't want to pay the bill now.

conversations.title: Asking for Change
conversations.description: Ask a cashier to break a large banknote for a vending machine.

messages.text: Salve! Come posso aiutarla?
messages.english: Hello! How can I help you?

choices.text: Salve, mi scusi. Può cambiare questa banconota da venti euro? Mi servono monete.
choices.english: Hello, excuse me. Can you change this twenty euro note? I need coins.
choices.feedback: Perfect. You clearly stated what you need.

choices.text: Salve, voglio comprare subito una bottiglia d'acqua fredda.
choices.english: Hello, I want to buy a cold bottle of water right away.
choices.feedback: You are asking for change, not buying water directly.

choices.text: Salve, mi scusi. Dove si trova la stazione dei treni qui?
choices.english: Hello, excuse me. Where is the train station here?
choices.feedback: You are at a shop asking for change, not directions.

messages.text: Certo. Le servono monete per la macchinetta del caffè?
messages.english: Sure. Do you need coins for the coffee machine?

choices.text: Sì, esatto. La macchinetta accetta solo monete da uno o due euro.
choices.english: Yes, exactly. The machine only accepts one or two euro coins.
choices.feedback: Good. Confirming the reason makes the exchange easier.

choices.text: Sì, esatto. Voglio pagare tutto con la carta di credito.
choices.english: Yes, exactly. I want to pay everything with the credit card.
choices.feedback: You can't use a card if you need coins.

choices.text: Sì, esatto. La macchinetta è guasta e non funziona bene.
choices.english: Yes, exactly. The machine is broken and doesn't work well.
choices.feedback: If it's broken, you wouldn't need coins for it.

messages.text: Capisco. Va bene se le do due banconote da cinque e dieci monete da un euro?
messages.english: I understand. Is it okay if I give you two five-euro notes and ten one-euro coins?

choices.text: Va benissimo, grazie. È proprio quello che mi serve.
choices.english: That's fine, thanks. It's exactly what I need.
choices.feedback: Excellent response. It perfectly solves your problem.

choices.text: No, mi dispiace, non ho spiccioli con me oggi pomeriggio.
choices.english: No, I'm sorry, I don't have change with me this afternoon.
choices.feedback: You are receiving change, not giving it.

choices.text: Va benissimo, grazie. Devo andare in ospedale adesso.
choices.english: That's fine, thanks. I have to go to the hospital now.

messages.text: Ecco a lei. Cinque, dieci... e dieci monete da un euro. Controlli pure.
messages.english: Here you go. Five, ten... and ten one-euro coins. Go ahead and check.

choices.text: È tutto giusto, la ringrazio molto per la cortesia.
choices.english: Everything is correct, thank you very much for your courtesy.
choices.feedback: Polite confirmation that the money is correct.

choices.text: Il codice pin è sbagliato, devo riprovare ancora una volta.
choices.english: The PIN code is wrong, I have to try once again.
choices.feedback: You are not using a card right now.

choices.text: Il conto non è giusto, mancano cinque euro da qui.
choices.english: The bill is not right, five euros are missing from here.

messages.text: Di nulla! Buona pausa caffè.
messages.english: You're welcome! Enjoy your coffee break.

choices.text: Grazie, buona giornata anche a lei e buon lavoro!
choices.english: Thanks, have a good day too and have a good work!

choices.text: Il caffè al bar è molto buono, costa due euro.
choices.english: The coffee at the bar is very good, it costs two euros.
choices.feedback: You are just saying goodbye, not reviewing the coffee.

choices.text: Voglio anche pagare il conto del ristorante oggi.
choices.english: I also want to pay the restaurant bill today.
choices.feedback: You are not at a restaurant.

messages.text: Scusi, posso chiederle un favore mentre è qui?
messages.english: Excuse me, can I ask you a favor while you are here?

choices.text: Certo, mi dica pure. Come posso aiutarla?
choices.english: Sure, tell me. How can I help you?

choices.text: No, non ho monete con me.
choices.english: No, I don't have coins with me.
choices.feedback: You just got coins from them.

choices.text: Il bagno è chiuso, mi dispiace.
choices.english: The bathroom is closed, I'm sorry.

messages.text: Per caso ha anche una moneta da due euro da cambiare in spiccioli?
messages.english: By any chance do you also have a two euro coin to change into small change?

choices.text: Sì, guardo nel portafoglio. Ecco qui una moneta da due euro.
choices.english: Yes, I look in my wallet. Here is a two euro coin.

choices.text: Voglio pagare con la carta di credito, grazie.
choices.english: I want to pay with credit card, thanks.
choices.feedback: You are making change, not paying.

choices.text: Il biglietto costa troppo per me.
choices.english: The ticket costs too much for me.

messages.text: Perfetto! Le do dieci monete da venti centesimi, va bene?
messages.english: Perfect! I give you ten twenty-cent coins, is that okay?

choices.text: Sì, va benissimo. Le monete piccole sono sempre utili.
choices.english: Yes, that's fine. Small coins are always useful.

choices.text: No, voglio cento euro in contanti subito.
choices.english: No, I want one hundred euros in cash immediately.
choices.feedback: That's not equal to two euros.

choices.text: Questa borsa costa cinquanta euro.
choices.english: This bag costs fifty euros.

messages.text: Ottimo, ecco i suoi venti centesimi. La ringrazio molto per l'aiuto.
messages.english: Great, here are your twenty cents. Thank you very much for your help.

choices.text: Di nulla, figurati. È stato un piacere aiutarla.
choices.english: You're welcome, don't mention it. It was a pleasure helping you.

choices.text: Il pin è sbagliato, provo ancora.
choices.english: The pin is wrong, I try again.

choices.text: Voglio uno scontrino per questo favore.
choices.english: I want a receipt for this favor.
choices.feedback: You don't get a receipt for changing money.

messages.text: Bene, ora può andare a prendere il suo caffè. Arrivederci!
messages.english: Well, now you can go get your coffee. Goodbye!

choices.text: Grazie ancora, a presto e buon lavoro!
choices.english: Thanks again, see you soon and good work!

choices.text: Il treno parte in ritardo oggi.
choices.english: The train leaves late today.

choices.text: Non mi piace il caffè caldo.
choices.english: I don't like hot coffee.

conversations.title: Card Declined
conversations.description: Try to pay with a card, but it gets declined. Solve the problem.

messages.text: Il totale è venticinque euro e cinquanta centesimi. Come desidera pagare?
messages.english: The total is twenty-five euros and fifty cents. How would you like to pay?

choices.text: Pago con la carta, per favore. Posso usare il contactless?
choices.english: I'll pay by card, please. Can I use contactless?
choices.feedback: Good. You specified the payment method clearly.

choices.text: Pago in contanti oggi. Non ho la carta di credito con me.
choices.english: I pay in cash today. I don't have the credit card with me.
choices.feedback: The scenario requires you to try paying with a card.

choices.text: Voglio parlare con il direttore del negozio, per favore.
choices.english: I want to talk to the store manager, please.
choices.feedback: This is completely out of context.

messages.text: Certamente, avvicini pure la carta al pos. Attenda un momento...
messages.english: Certainly, just bring the card close to the POS. Wait a moment...

choices.text: Va bene, la avvicino subito. Spero che funzioni bene oggi.
choices.english: Alright, I bring it close right away. I hope it works well today.

choices.text: Il bancomat è guasto, devo andare in un'altra banca.
choices.english: The ATM is broken, I have to go to another bank.
choices.feedback: You don't know it's broken yet.

choices.text: Questa banconota è finta, non la voglio usare per pagare.
choices.english: This banknote is fake, I don't want to use it to pay.
choices.feedback: You are paying by card, not cash.

messages.text: Mi dispiace, ma la carta è stata rifiutata. Vuole riprovare inserendola?
messages.english: I'm sorry, but the card was declined. Do you want to try again by inserting it?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. A volte fa i capricci. Inserisco la carta e digito il pin.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. Sometimes it acts up. I insert the card and type the pin.

choices.text: No, la macchina è sicuramente rotta. Non voglio pagare nulla.
choices.english: No, the machine is definitely broken. I don't want to pay anything.
choices.feedback: A bit aggressive and not constructive.

choices.text: Sì, voglio pagare con le monete da due euro adesso, grazie.
choices.english: Yes, I want to pay with two euro coins now, thanks.
choices.feedback: You want to try the card again first.

messages.text: Transazione negata di nuovo. Ha per caso un'altra carta o dei contanti?
messages.english: Transaction denied again. Do you happen to have another card or cash?

choices.text: Che strano! Per fortuna ho dei contanti. Ecco trenta euro qui.
choices.english: How strange! Luckily I have cash. Here is thirty euros.
choices.feedback: Good backup plan. Handing cash to solve the issue.

choices.text: Non ho soldi con me. Posso pagare la settimana prossima?
choices.english: I don't have money with me. Can I pay next week?
choices.feedback: Usually not acceptable in a normal shop.

choices.text: Il mio volo per Roma parte tra dieci minuti, mi scusi tanto.
choices.english: My flight to Rome leaves in ten minutes, I'm so sorry.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant and doesn't solve the payment.

messages.text: Va bene. Trenta euro... ecco quattro euro e cinquanta di resto. Mi dispiace per l'inconveniente.
messages.english: Alright. Thirty euros... here is four euros and fifty cents change. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

choices.text: Nessun problema, capita a tutti. Grazie per il resto, arrivederci!
choices.english: No problem, it happens to everyone. Thanks for the change, goodbye!

choices.text: Il resto è sbagliato, dovete darmi dieci euro oggi pomeriggio.
choices.english: The change is wrong, you have to give me ten euros this afternoon.
choices.feedback: The change is 30 - 25.50 = 4.50, so it's correct.

choices.text: Non voglio questo resto, voglio i miei soldi indietro adesso.
choices.english: I don't want this change, I want my money back right now.
choices.feedback: You need to pay for your items!

messages.text: A proposito, il sistema dei pagamenti elettronici ha problemi da ieri.
messages.english: By the way, the electronic payment system has been having problems since yesterday.

choices.text: Ah, ecco perché la carta non funzionava. Tutto chiaro adesso.
choices.english: Ah, that's why the card wasn't working. Everything is clear now.

choices.text: Voglio pagare con la mia carta di credito americana.
choices.english: I want to pay with my American credit card.

choices.text: Il cibo del ristorante non era buono.
choices.english: The restaurant food wasn't good.

messages.text: Sì, stiamo aspettando il tecnico per riparare la linea internet.
messages.english: Yes, we are waiting for the technician to repair the internet line.

choices.text: Spero che riescano a risolvere il guasto velocemente.
choices.english: I hope they manage to fix the fault quickly.

choices.text: Voglio un tecnico per il mio computer a casa.
choices.english: I want a technician for my computer at home.

choices.text: Il prezzo di questa borsa è troppo alto.
choices.english: The price of this bag is too high.

messages.text: Lo spero anche io! Per fortuna lei aveva dei contanti in tasca.
messages.english: I hope so too! Luckily you had some cash in your pocket.

choices.text: Sì, porto sempre un po' di soldi con me per sicurezza.
choices.english: Yes, I always carry a little money with me for safety.

choices.text: Io non ho mai contanti, mi dispiace.
choices.english: I never have cash, I'm sorry.

choices.text: La banca è molto lontana da qui.
choices.english: The bank is very far from here.

messages.text: È un'ottima abitudine. Grazie per la pazienza e la comprensione.
messages.english: It's a great habit. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

choices.text: Figurati, nessun problema. Buona continuazione e buon lavoro.
choices.english: Don't mention it, no problem. Have a good continuation and good work.

choices.text: Non voglio questo scontrino, voglio i soldi indietro.
choices.english: I don't want this receipt, I want the money back.

choices.text: Voglio comprare anche un giornale ora.
choices.english: I want to buy a newspaper now too.

messages.text: Grazie mille, arrivederci e buona giornata!
messages.english: Thank you very much, goodbye and have a good day!

choices.text: Grazie, arrivederci!
choices.english: Thanks, goodbye!

choices.text: Il resto è sbagliato.
choices.english: The change is wrong.

choices.text: Mi dia la borsa.
choices.english: Give me the bag.

conversations.title: Understanding Prices
conversations.description: Ask about the price of items and point out a mistake on the receipt.

messages.text: Salve! Cerca qualcosa in particolare o sta solo guardando?
messages.english: Hello! Are you looking for something in particular or just looking?

choices.text: Salve. Vorrei sapere quanto costa questa borsa, non vedo il prezzo.
choices.english: Hello. I would like to know how much this bag costs, I don't see the price.
choices.feedback: Good question to find out the cost.

choices.text: Salve. Voglio comprare tutto il negozio, ho moltissimi soldi oggi.
choices.english: Hello. I want to buy the whole shop, I have a lot of money today.

choices.text: Salve. Il museo è chiuso oggi per una festa nazionale importante.
choices.english: Hello. The museum is closed today for an important national holiday.
choices.feedback: You are in a shop, not near a museum.

messages.text: Quella borsa costa quarantacinque euro. È in saldo al venti percento.
messages.english: That bag costs forty-five euros. It is on sale at twenty percent off.

choices.text: Quarantacinque euro con lo sconto? Perfetto, la prendo. Pago con carta.
choices.english: Forty-five euros with the discount? Perfect, I'll take it. I pay by card.
choices.feedback: Great. You confirmed the price and decided to buy it.

choices.text: È troppo costosa per me, voglio pagarla solo quindici euro oggi.
choices.english: It is too expensive for me, I want to pay only fifteen euros for it today.
choices.feedback: Haggling is usually not accepted like this.

choices.text: Non mi piace il colore, è troppo scuro per i miei gusti personali.
choices.english: I don't like the color, it's too dark for my personal tastes.
choices.feedback: But the scenario requires you to buy it and check the receipt.

messages.text: Ottima scelta. Inserisca la carta qui. Vuole lo scontrino nel sacchetto?
messages.english: Excellent choice. Insert the card here. Do you want the receipt in the bag?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Preferisco controllare sempre lo scontrino prima di uscire.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. I always prefer to check the receipt before leaving.

choices.text: No, non voglio lo scontrino. Voglio solo andare a casa a dormire.
choices.english: No, I don't want the receipt. I just want to go home to sleep.
choices.feedback: You need the receipt for the next step of the scenario.

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Il conto del ristorante era molto alto prima di venire.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. The restaurant bill was very high before coming.

messages.text: Certo, faccia pure. Ecco la sua borsa e lo scontrino. Tutto a posto?
messages.english: Sure, go ahead. Here is your bag and the receipt. Is everything okay?

choices.text: Mi scusi, credo ci sia un errore. Ha digitato cinquanta euro invece di quarantacinque.
choices.english: Excuse me, I think there is a mistake. You typed fifty euros instead of forty-five.
choices.feedback: Good catch! You spotted the mistake politely.

choices.text: Tutto a posto, grazie. Questa borsa è davvero bellissima da usare.
choices.english: Everything is fine, thanks. This bag is really beautiful to use.
choices.feedback: You missed the opportunity to correct the receipt.

choices.text: Mi scusi, credo ci sia un gatto randagio sotto il tavolo laggiù.
choices.english: Excuse me, I think there is a stray cat under the table over there.

messages.text: Oh, ha ragione! Mi scusi tanto. Le rido i cinque euro di differenza in contanti, va bene?
messages.english: Oh, you are right! I am so sorry. I'll give you the five euros difference in cash, is that okay?

choices.text: Sì, va benissimo. Grazie per aver risolto il problema così in fretta.
choices.english: Yes, that's fine. Thanks for solving the problem so quickly.

choices.text: No, voglio chiamare subito la polizia per questa truffa gigantesca.
choices.english: No, I want to call the police immediately for this huge scam.
choices.feedback: A huge overreaction to a small mistake.

choices.text: Sì, va benissimo. Vado a prendere un buon caffè al bar adesso.
choices.english: Yes, that's fine. I'm going to get a good coffee at the bar now.

messages.text: Ha notato anche la nostra nuova collezione di portafogli in pelle?
messages.english: Did you also notice our new collection of leather wallets?

choices.text: Sì, li ho visti. Sono molto belli, ma non mi servono oggi.
choices.english: Yes, I saw them. They are very beautiful, but I don't need them today.

choices.text: Sì, voglio pagare il portafoglio in contanti.
choices.english: Yes, I want to pay for the wallet in cash.
choices.feedback: You didn't decide to buy it.

choices.text: La borsa è rotta, voglio restituirla.
choices.english: The bag is broken, I want to return it.

messages.text: Nessun problema. Le lascio un nostro biglietto da visita per la prossima volta.
messages.english: No problem. I leave you our business card for next time.

choices.text: Grazie, lo prendo volentieri. Magari torno il mese prossimo.
choices.english: Thanks, I take it gladly. Maybe I'll come back next month.

choices.text: Questo biglietto del treno è scaduto.
choices.english: This train ticket is expired.
choices.feedback: It's a business card, not a train ticket.

choices.text: Non voglio comprare la pelle oggi.
choices.english: I don't want to buy leather today.

messages.text: Saremo felici di rivederla. A proposito, abbiamo anche un sito online.
messages.english: We will be happy to see you again. By the way, we also have an online website.

choices.text: Ottimo, controllerò il sito se mi serve qualcos'altro in futuro.
choices.english: Great, I'll check the website if I need anything else in the future.

choices.text: Il mio internet non funziona da due giorni.
choices.english: My internet hasn't been working for two days.

choices.text: Voglio pagare con il bancomat per questo sito.
choices.english: I want to pay with a debit card for this site.
choices.feedback: You aren't buying anything online right now.

messages.text: Perfetto. Spero che la borsa le piaccia, è di ottima qualità.
messages.english: Perfect. I hope you like the bag, it is of excellent quality.

choices.text: Ne sono sicuro. Mi piace molto il materiale morbido e il colore.
choices.english: I am sure of it. I really like the soft material and the color.

choices.text: Il colore è bruttissimo, ho cambiato idea.
choices.english: The color is very ugly, I changed my mind.
choices.feedback: You just said it was an excellent choice.

choices.text: Non mi interessa la qualità, voglio solo il resto.
choices.english: I don't care about the quality, I just want the change.

messages.text: Sono contento. Allora arrivederci e grazie per l'acquisto!
messages.english: I'm glad. Goodbye then and thank you for your purchase!

choices.text: Grazie a lei. Arrivederci e buona serata!
choices.english: Thank you. Goodbye and have a good evening!

choices.text: La polizia è già qui fuori.
choices.english: The police is already outside here.

choices.text: Voglio comprare tutto il negozio.
choices.english: I want to buy the whole shop.
